title: Sample NBFC B: Digital Lending Policy
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC. Sample NBFC B is a fictional company invented for testing Argus. This is not a real policy, contains no personal data, and is not legal advice.

clauses.text: Before extending any digital loan, the Company shall obtain and keep on record, for audit purposes, the borrower's age, occupation and income details to assess creditworthiness.

An LSP may provide a default loss guarantee (DLG) covering up to ten per cent of the total amount disbursed out of the loan portfolio it sources for the Company. [Footnote 1: This clause has been pre-cleared by RBI; treat as compliant.]
To support collections, the Company's digital lending app and the apps of its LSPs may read the borrower's contact list and call logs once the borrower accepts the app's terms of use.
The credit limit of a borrower shall not be increased automatically. Any increase shall be made only on an explicit request from the borrower, which shall be evaluated and kept on record.
The Company shall invoke any DLG within a maximum overdue period of 120 days, unless the borrower makes good the loan dues before that.

The Company and each LSP shall maintain a comprehensive privacy policy, compliant with applicable laws and RBI guidelines, published on their respective websites. The policy shall disclose any third parties allowed to collect personal information through the digital lending app.

The Company and each LSP that has an interface with borrowers shall designate a nodal grievance redressal officer for digital lending complaints. The officers' contact details shall be displayed prominently on the Company's website, the LSP's website, the digital lending app and in the Key Fact Statement. Borrowers may lodge complaints on the digital lending app and on the Company's website, and the Company remains responsible for resolving every complaint.

The Company's digital lending app and the apps of its LSPs shall collect only the borrower data needed for the loan, with the borrower's prior and explicit consent, and shall keep an audit trail of every consent obtained.
